bugs.error_message: SQLITE_CONSTRAINT: NOT NULL constraint failed: monitor.conditions
bugs.root_cause: Uptime Kuma >=1.23.x enforces NOT NULL on monitor.conditions but uptime-kuma-api library does not pass that field. The failure in ensure_group() propagated into the HTTPRoute CRD discovery except handler, mislogging it as 'HTTPRoute CRD not available' instead of the real cause.
bugs.fix: Monkey-patched UptimeKumaApi._build_monitor_data at module load to inject conditions=[] into its returned dict. Wrapped ensure_group() calls in try/except so failures log with correct context. Also fixed Helm deployment.yaml to skip the ConfigMap /app mount when useCustomImage=true (otherwise the ConfigMap overwrites the fixed script in the image).

bugs.error_message: UptimeKumaApi._build_monitor_data() got an unexpected keyword argument 'conditions'
bugs.root_cause: uptime-kuma-api._build_monitor_data() has a strict parameter signature with no **kwargs — it rejects unknown keyword arguments. Passing conditions=[] directly to add_monitor()/edit_monitor() triggers this error because the library doesn't know about 'conditions' yet.
bugs.fix: Removed conditions=[] from all explicit add_monitor/edit_monitor kwargs. Instead, monkey-patched _build_monitor_data to pop 'conditions' from incoming kwargs (safe no-op if absent) then inject conditions=[] into the returned data dict before it is sent over the WebSocket.
